title: Replace DateTime.now() with a fixed clock in UserDatabase migration/smoke test setup
why: 29 wall-clock DateTime.now() calls across these 3 files (6 + 17 + 6) stamp createdAt/activatedAt/stateChangedAt instead of using a fixed constant. None currently assert date-boundary behavior, so today it's inert risk rather than an active flake — but TQ-6 requires hermetic tests specifically so a later change elsewhere in the same file doesn't silently start comparing against a moving 'now' (e.g. a future staleness/ordering assertion would flake once a day near a UTC boundary, and CI's randomized test ordering would make the failure look like it came from an unrelated test).
recommendation: Replace DateTime.now()/DateTime.now().toUtc() with a fixed DateTime.utc(...) constant, matching the pattern already used elsewhere in these same files (e.g. schema_v1_smoke_test.dart's DateTime.utc(2026, 1, 1) at line 258).
acceptance_criteria: grep for 'DateTime.now(' in these 3 files returns zero.
TQ-6's Pending checker (currently lib/-only via inner audit check 6) is extended to cover test/.
